note: Passages of the Justice Sector Reform Strategy 2024-2030. For the Sierra Leone Police it plans a new Police Act, recruitment and training, more police stations with Family Support Units, and 'modern policing vehicles, communication and other equipment, gadgets, hardware and software' (activity 3.1.3, enabling); it names no police information system and says nothing on how stations record reports or cases. The 'modern digital case management infrastructure' of activity 3.2.4 is the Correctional Service's.
